articles.summary: Focal Systems is proud to announce that it has been awarded the prestigious 2024 Digital Transformation Project of the Year for its groundbreaking partnership with Morrisons. This recognition highlights the largest-scale computer vision deployment in grocery retail, revolutionizing store operations and enhancing customer experiences.
